source_qualifier: Baseline product source plus the three test-only screenshot harness changes included with this evidence. No product UI modifications.
application_version: 0.2.0 CMake default; native fixtures, not a packaged application release

settings.surface: Production SettingsWindow instantiated by lemonvox_settings_ui_test; Xvfb, Cairo renderer, private D-Bus session, synthetic callbacks and model inventory
settings.health: Synthetic connected status; no server health or downloaded model claim
settings.command: GDK_SCALE=1 GSK_RENDERER=cairo xvfb-run -a dbus-run-session -- .build/ubuntu/lemonvox_settings_ui_test OUTPUT.png light|dark General|Models|Diagnostics connected

bar.surface: Production extension in isolated native headless GNOME Wayland compositor; synthetic D-Bus backend and disposable synthetic target field
bar.viewport: 1280x800 compositor pixels, default private compositor scale 1 (100%)
bar.theme: System Shell appearance, dark bar surface; no forced light/dark bar comparison
bar.palette: LEMONVOX_TEST_PALETTE='' disables the fixture's artificial low-contrast test palette so production fallback uses native Shell colors

verification.native_shell: PASS: isolated GNOME Shell extension enable/disable test, including requested recording/processing/error capture
verification.visual_review: All nine PNGs inspected; default-size Settings content scrolls below viewport, Models selection labels ellipsize using native controls

limitations: These are native current-source fixture captures, not screenshots of a shipped package or end-to-end audio/inference.
General and Models show only the initial scroll viewport; lower controls and prompt are not included.
System-following Settings appearance, light/dark bar variants, fractional/high scaling, minimum sizes, screen reader and complete keyboard navigation remain unverified.
Connected status and installed model choices are synthetic and do not attest to live server availability.
